title: Human Development and Family Studies, B.S. — Human Development and Family Science Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: Human Development and Family Science Option, University Park (of two; the other, Developmental Science for Health Professions, needs a 4-item 'Science and Health Foundations' pool from an unspecified approved list -- confirmed real and distinct against the live bulletin, not modeled here). The HDFS department catalog was already largely populated. Real bug avoided: the 'HDFS 200/EDPSY 101/STAT 200' statistics item lists STAT 200 first (not HDFS 200), since HDFS 312W's own prereq only recognizes EDPSY 101/STAT 200, not HDFS 200 -- same class of mismatch as the recurring MATH 110-vs-140 pattern earlier this session. The bulletin's 'HDFS Capstone' (Fall 3cr + Spring 12cr, with 'traditional internship, modified internship, experiential mix, or research emphasis' pathways left to student/adviser choice, no single official course sequence) is split into a real, concrete Fall item -- HDFS 490 (Professional Development and Preparation for Internship Experience, the actual required precursor for every pathway) -- and a generic Spring slot, since the specific follow-on course genuinely varies by chosen pathway and isn't pinned down by the bulletin itself. Real prereq-fix fallout: STAT 200 now requires MATH 21 (never scheduled, same remedial-chain issue hit elsewhere this batch), permanently blocking that option -- the item's own EDPSY 101 fallback (zero prereqs) was already the intended safety net per the note above, but EDPSY wasn't in this plan's departments list, so the engine's option-ranking couldn't see EDPSY 101 as catalog-present and fell through to the wrong fallback, HDFS 200, instead (which HDFS 312W doesn't recognize). Fix was just adding 'EDPSY' to the departments list -- no item changes needed, the existing STAT 200/EDPSY 101/HDFS 200 pool now resolves correctly on its own. Handbook verification pass: no separate HDFS undergraduate handbook is publicly published, but the live bulletin (bulletins.psu.edu, 2026-27 edition) publishes exact real course lists for 'Advanced Development', 'Advanced Family Topics', and 'Professional Skills for HDFS Careers' directly in its own requirements table (not just the suggested plan), and links to a real department page (hhd.psu.edu/hdfs/.../diversity-and) for 'Diversity and Development'. All four were previously fully generic unfillable placeholders; wired to their real lists. Also found and fixed three real Gen-Ed-wiring bugs by diffing this plan's item order against the live Suggested Academic Plan: both 'GEN ED (Integrative Studies)' items (Semester 1 and Semester 4) were never actually wired to the engine's Inter-Domain picker (a mislabeled-but-unwired placeholder, same bug class as CMPSC's 'GN'-labeled slot) -- added gen_ed: INTER-D to both; and Semester 3's real 5th item is an Inter-Domain Gen Ed course, not a generic 'Elective' as this plan previously modeled it -- changed to a wired 'GEN ED (Inter-Domain)' slot. 'Diversity and Development' can alternatively be satisfied by 'HDFS at any level' per the bulletin's own text -- this plan uses the bulletin's own curated cross-department list instead (a real, complete way to satisfy the requirement, not the full 'or any HDFS course' branch, which would require enumerating the entire HDFS catalog). Two of the list's real codes (CRIMJ 150N, RLST 137) have no locally-scraped catalog file for their departments (Criminology's own catalog here is keyed 'CRIM', not 'CRIMJ', and no Religious Studies catalog exists at all) -- left them in as unchecked fallback options, same tolerance used elsewhere this session.
